items.t: Where Upwork Goes After A 58% Drop
items.sum: Upwork entered 2026 with upbeat talk about AI-fuelled demand, bigger remote work budgets, and analysts debating whether the upside or the downside case deserved more weight. For Upwork shareholders, the loss from the start of the year was 57.6%, including dividends. If you had been deciding on 1 January whether to commit fresh capital, what signals about client demand, AI disruption and legal risk

items.t: LinkedIn CEO Says Job Market Is ‘Frozen’ for Gen Z, But AI Skills and Networking Could Help — Data Reveals ‘Fastest Path’ to a Job
items.sum: LinkedIn CEO says AI is making entry-level hiring tougher, but Gen Z can stand out with AI skills and networking.
